items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was going to ask, Nick Allen wanted me to ask if anybody made any records up there. Do you know of any of those fellows?

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play a 12 string guitar. That guy was good. Oh yeah, he's really good. And so they had another fellow used to play guitar. Let me see what his name is. He dead now. Yeah, he used to play in that band too, but he dead.
I was going to ask, Nick Allen wanted me to ask if anybody made any records up there. Do you know of any of those fellows?
No, they never made, not to my name Mr. Billy, they never made no records, not to my name.
